note: Private RV park just east of Regina on the south side of Highway 1, a few minutes from the city's east-end stores; treed loops beside open prairie. Water at the sites is non-potable (bottled water sold at the office). Caters to monthly guests such as contractors as well as nightly travellers. --Claude
summary: DROP CANDIDATE on Google rating 3.8 (207 reviews). Otherwise passes: 75 sites (26 pull-thru, 42 back-in, 7 tent), 30/50 A full service, C$45-55 nightly posted, Let's Camp online booking (60 of 68 RV sites offered by the night), open year-round. Count 76 -> 75; site water non-potable.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (Google rating): Google Maps 'Buffalo Lookout Campground & RV Park' 3.8 stars, 207 reviews (read 2026-11-18): under 4.0 with 25+ reviews.

LONG-STAY: the home page markets 'Affordable nightly & monthly rates', 'Ideal for contractors & travelling nurses', 'Whether you're staying for one night or an entire season'; rate page 'Long-term stays available'. Nightly share: Let's Camp offers 60 of the 68 RV sites (plus all 7 tent sites) for online nightly booking with no minimum (~89%); daily rates posted. Passes the five tests; no wording discourages nightly guests.

PRICE: cheapest electric night C$45 (30 A power & water, e.g. pull-thru site 52, 45x19 ft); passes the C$69 gate without a gateway. Peak = same (no seasonal pricing posted). Extra person over 4: C$10.

SITES: stored count 76 (note prose) -> 75 (operator map). Let's Camp bio says 25 pull-thru/43 back-in; the operator map lists 26/42. Site sizes posted per site (back-ins mostly ~30 ft, e.g. site 3 '21X29', 53 '23X13', 54 '17X14'); max_rig_ft not written (sizes are pad dimensions, not a rig limit).
FACILITIES: potable_water not written: 'Water supplied at campsites is non-potable'; bottled water sold.
PRESENCE: website + phone (306) 525-1448 confirmed; Google 207 reviews.
PIN: fine. Stored 50.44636,-104.4457 sits inside the loops (Google place 50.4471,-104.4455, ~80 m).
WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' confirmed (a narrow drainage channel along the east edge only).
